about.body: The S63TU is BMW M's twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 petrol engine, an evolution of the original S63. It's the engine powering the X5 M and X6 M high-performance SUVs — two of the most powerful production SUVs BMW has ever built. The "TU" designation stands for "Technical Update," reflecting refinements made to the original S63 design.

byModel.body: Across the X5 M range, the S63TU powers both the F85 generation (2015–2018) and the current F95 generation (2019–present), in both standard and Competition form. The X6 M follows the same pattern, using the S63TU in the F86 generation (2015–2019) and the current F96 generation (2020–present).

compatibility.body: Because the S63TU spans two different models and multiple generations, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. Ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ between applications — we confirm everything before any work begins.
